finding: git record-commit --dry-run accepted a low-risk TASK-GIT-0024 historical work-admission attestation bundle, but the real record-commit failed in the host pre-commit hook with ATM_CROSS_TASK_MUTATION_BLOCKED because the hook saw the files as owned by active task TASK-GIT-0024 while record-commit is task-session-free and forbids --task.
expectedBehavior: record-commit dry-run and write must share the same ownership predicate. If TASK-GIT-0024 owns the global historical attestation ledger, record-commit should either carry that owner context into the hook or fail during dry-run with the exact recovery command before staging/commit is attempted.
evidenceOrRepro: After creating .atm/history/evidence/TASK-GIT-0024.forward-provenance-2026-07-31-skl-plan4.json and updating .atm/history/evidence/TASK-GIT-0024.historical-work-admission-attestations.json, node atm.mjs git record-commit --actor codex-skl-captain --message "chore(git): attest historical work admission" --dry-run --json returned ATM_GIT_RECORD_COMMIT_DRY_RUN. The matching write command failed with ATM_GIT_COMMIT_FAILED wrapping ATM_CROSS_TASK_MUTATION_BLOCKED for the same two files. Retrying record-commit with --task TASK-GIT-0024 was rejected with ATM_GIT_RECORD_COMMIT_TASK_FORBIDDEN.
followUp: Add parity tests for record-commit dry-run/write on TASK-GIT-0024 attestation files and decide whether record-commit should be able to pass a read-only owner context to pre-commit, or whether a dedicated git attest commit surface should own this ledger.
